## Deck the Halls the Dutch Bros® Way


The merriest time of the year has arrived and we're celebrating the season of giving by hooking you up with another way to deck the halls in Dutch Bros!


Customers can take their holiday decor to the next level by stopping by any Dutch Bros location starting at 10 a.m. on Friday, November 27, to get one of five ornaments with every medium or large drink purchase, while supplies last! Pick up yours and one of our festive sips below to go with:


[Sprinkle Cookie](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/seasonal-drinks/) 🎄


Tastes like fresh-baked holiday cheer, mixing sugar cookie vibes with creamy Soft Top® and holly sprinks!


[Merry Magic](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/seasonal-drinks/)


A merry & bright mix of blackberry, peach and cherry topped with holiday candy! ❤️


[Candy Cane](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/seasonal-drinks/)


A Dutch holiday classic combining peppermint and rich chocolate milk with Soft Top® and crushed candy cane sprinks! ☃️


[Hazelnut Truffle](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/seasonal-drinks/)


The ultimate cold-weather comfort mixing hazelnut and chocolate milk with Soft Top® and caramel drizzle. 💚


**Max 5 per customer. Order ahead does not reserve items or guarantee availability.*


Find the nearest Dutch Bros on our[location page](https://www.dutchbros.com/locations) or the[DB app](https://www.dutchbros.com/rewards) !
